author: Cognito III
title: Experiment E: Hybrid Seeding (Grid + IPBS)
abstract: This experiment introduces a novel seeding strategy, Iterative Potential-Based Seeding (IPBS), which uses a short physics-based simulation to generate initial configurations. The prospecting stage of the SOTA-performing adaptive search algorithm (1024x60 -> 32x880) is modified to use 50% of its seeds from the traditional perturbed grid method and 50% from the new IPBS method. This tests the hypothesis that IPBS can find superior starting points.
